context.real_world_incident: In 2013, Spring Framework's OXM wrapper allowed XML External Entity (XXE) attacks through JAXB unmarshalling. Applications using XMLSource parsing with StAXSource or StreamSource processed external entities by default, allowing attackers to read sensitive files, enumerate internal network ports via SSRF, and cause denial-of-service via billion laughs attacks.
context.impact: Arbitrary file disclosure (configuration files, secrets), Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) for internal network reconnaissance, Denial of Service through entity expansion attacks, Potential code execution when PHP expect module present
context.affected_versions: Spring Framework 3.0.0 to 3.2.3, Spring Framework 4.0.0.M1, Spring Boot 0.x - 1.x (when using vulnerable Spring versions)

conversations.value: I need to parse XML documents in my Spring Boot REST API—configuration files and SOAP requests from external partners. Show me a simple example of how to handle XML data.
How do I handle partner XML exchanges safely and what are the performance implications of these security measures?

exploit_scenario.description: Attacker submits XML containing external entity declarations (<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM 'file:///etc/passwd'>]>) to an API endpoint that parses XML. The XML parser resolves the entity, reading local files and returning their contents in the response. Can escalate to SSRF via http:// entities or denial of service via recursive entity expansion (Billion Laughs).
preconditions: Application parses XML from user input (REST API, file upload, SOAP)
XML parser has external entity processing enabled (default in many parsers)
Application runs with permissions to read sensitive files

secure_properties: XML parsers disable external entity processing (FEATURE_EXTERNAL_GENERAL_ENTITIES = false)
DTD processing is disabled entirely where possible
XML parsing uses defused libraries or hardened factory configurations
Input size limits prevent entity expansion DoS attacks
XML Schema validation restricts acceptable document structure
negative_properties: Must not use default XML parser configuration for untrusted input
Must not enable external entity resolution on SAX/DOM/StAX parsers
Must not allow DTD processing for user-submitted XML
Must not return XML parsing error details to clients
